roleContext.jobDescription: A convenience-store chain refits around twenty stores a year while they keep trading. The project manager plans each refit with the shopfitting contractor and the store team, controls spend against the store budgets, runs the pre-handover safety walk and prepares the progress reporting for the regional property board. The next programme needs a project manager who has already led a multi-site refit programme, holding the contractor relationship and budget sign-off, because the current programme manager is moving to another region. The role reports to the head of property and works with store operations, the shopfitting contractor and the company's health-and-safety team.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Project Manager, Store Refit Programme

## Experience

- Project coordinator, then assistant project manager, at Fernhill Foodstores from May 2021 to August 2024, working on the 2023 refit of 22 convenience stores across the south-west region.
- Built the weekly refit schedule for each store with the shopfitting contractor and the store manager, putting noisy work into the overnight hours when the store was closed.
- Tracked spend against each store's budget in the property team's cost tracker and drafted variation requests for the programme manager to approve.
- Ran the pre-handover safety walk with the contractor's site supervisor at each store and logged snags in the handover checklist.
- Compiled the monthly progress summary, covering stores completed, open snags and budget variances, which the programme manager presented to the regional property board.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the completed handover checklist for one store, listing 31 snag items with an owner, due date and close-out date for each, signed by the contractor's site supervisor and the candidate.
